image_description: A high-angle, slightly distant shot of an ornate religious altar situated within a church sanctuary. The altar consists of a white-clothed table in the foreground, backed by a large, elaborate stone or marble reredos (altarpiece) featuring Gothic-style arches, statues, and gold accents. Tall wooden columns flank the structure, and painted panels are visible on the sides. Candles and floral arrangements sit on the altar table.
